name: VoxCeleb1: Large-Scale Speaker Identification Dataset
description: VoxCeleb1 is a large-scale audio-visual dataset containing over 100,000 utterances for 1,251 celebrities, extracted from videos uploaded to YouTube. Introduced at Interspeech 2017 by Oxford's Visual Geometry Group, the dataset spans diverse acoustic environments, accents, and recording conditions, serving as a landmark global benchmark for speaker identification, speaker verification, and emotion recognition.
